subject: Request: Order Form amendment for incremental node top-up and billing waterfall
messages:
From: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@medicore.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@medicore.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form change request: short-term node top-up + billing waterfall

Hi Lauren,

Hope you had a good week. We're prepping for a product push and need a short-term capacity bump for 6 weeks: +40 nodes (in the Dedicated pool) starting 2026-04-01. Our procurement team asked whether we can: 
- Add a one-time top-up exhibit to the existing Order Form for the period 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-12,
- Apply a billing waterfall so the top-up consumes any existing credits first and then bills incremental usage, and
- Capture the rate for those nodes explicitly in an exhibit (they want avoid rate ambiguity).

We tried to sketch a proposed amendment but wanted Redwood to drive redlines so our legal can sign quickly. Can you confirm the path: 1) Redwood redlines (MSA + Order Form exhibit), 2) Medicore legal review, 3) DocuSign? Attached is our brief (topup_requirements.pdf) for context.

Two asks: can you provide a target rate for the top-up (per-node hourly or monthly SKU) and confirm whether the waterfall approach is acceptable from your billing side?

Thanks,
Rachel Torres
Head of Procurement
Medicore AI

Attachments: topup_requirements.pdf (summary), expected_volume_estimate.xlsx (stub)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood-inference.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Order Form change request: short-term node top-up + billing waterfall

Team — forwarding Medicore's request. High level: they want a timeboxed +40 node top-up and a billing waterfall (use credits first, then incremental billing). They asked us to produce redlines for both the Order Form (exhibit) and a short MSA amendment that references the billing waterfall.

Immediate asks for legal/ops:
- Jordan: can we do a one-off exhibit that lists exact SKU and rate for the 6-week window? If so, send a suggested SKU+rate (I think we can mirror Dedicated node SKU but add a short-term premium).
- Connor: ops, how quick is provisioning for a +40 burst to Dedicated? Any constraints on start date 2026-04-01? If not, I need a minimal SLO note in the exhibit (provisioning lead time 3 business days).
- Rachel K: please draft a concise amendment header referencing the MSA (MSA v2.1) and include the DocuSign workflow we should use (Medicore prefers single-signature on DocuSign followed by countersign).

I've attached a working redline template (redline_orderform_v3.docx) with placeholders. Aim to get a legal-ready redline back to me by EOD Wed 18 Mar so we can issue to Medicore and keep their timeline.

Thanks — LA

--
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: redline_orderform_v3.docx (working redline)

From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood-inference.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Order Form change request: short-term node top-up + billing waterfall

Lauren — quick answers:
- SKU/rate: propose using SKU DED-NODE-STD at $1.20/node/hour for committed capacity; for a short-term top-up we suggest $1.60/node/hour (33% premium) to account for burst reservation and scheduling. I'll put that into the Order Form exhibit lines.
- Waterfall: billing can honor credit consumption first, then bill incremental usage. We need explicit language: "Credits shall be applied to outstanding usage during the Top-Up Period in the following order: (a) existing pre-paid credits, (b) promotional credits, (c) invoiced usage at Top-Up Rates." I will draft a short clause.
- Provisioning: Connor confirms we can provision up to +50 nodes in Dedicated within 5 business days for a new top-up; if they need 2026-04-01 start, we should lock sign-off by 2026-03-27 to guarantee readiness. I'll note a 3-5 business day provisioning window in the exhibit.

I'll assemble redlines to the provided template and include a tracked change of the MSA amendment that references the Order Form exhibit. Expect my file by Wed EOD.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

(Internal attachment: redline_orderform_v3_JB.docx)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@medicore.ai>, Contracts Team <contracts@medicore.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood-inference.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood-inference.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form change request: short-term node top-up + billing waterfall

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear ask and the estimate. Attached are Redwood's proposed redlines: 1) a short MSA amendment that references MSA v2.1 and 2) an Order Form Exhibit (Top-Up Exhibit) that enumerates the 40-node SKU, effective 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-12. Key points summarized below so your legal team can review quickly: 

Summary of proposed changes
- Top-Up Exhibit: 40 nodes at SKU DED-NODE-STD (Top-Up Rate $1.60/node/hour) for the stated period. Total estimated top-up spend (not including credits): ~$69,120 (approx; depends on daily usage).
- Billing waterfall clause: credits applied first (pre-paid credits, then promotional), incremental usage invoiced at Top-Up Rates.
- Provisioning & SLO: Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to provision within 3-5 business days after countersign; to start 2026-04-01 we need countersign by 2026-03-27.
- Termination/rollback: exhibit includes a 48-hour cancellation for the top-up window prior to start date for administrative rollback (for both parties).

Next steps
1) Please review the attached redline_orderform_v3.docx and amendment_summary_20260318.pdf.
2) If acceptable, confirm DocuSign workflow (single-signature from Medicore followed by Redwood countersign). We will prepare the envelope and share link after Medicore's sign-off.
3) If you need different billing rules (e.g., prorated on calendar days vs hours), flag immediately — that will change invoicing calculations.

If Medicore is OK with the Top-Up Rate and waterfall language I'll route the DocuSign envelope immediately after you confirm.

Thanks,
Lauren
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
